rubric.name: Accuracy
rubric.description: How correct was the final output?

rubric.name: Speed
rubric.description: How quickly did the tool get to a useful answer?

rubric.name: Explanation
rubric.description: How well did it explain the reasoning and tradeoffs?

rubric.name: Cleanup
rubric.description: How much manual cleanup did you need after the result?

rubric.name: Business Value
rubric.description: How useful was the result in a real analyst or operator workflow?

tasks.title: Tool Triage Memo
tasks.scenario: Take 3 items from the latest briefing and write a short memo that labels each one watch, test, or implement.
tasks.artifact: One-page decision memo with reasoning and next step.

tasks.title: Natural Language to SQL
tasks.scenario: Turn a business question about revenue, churn, or customer behavior into safe SQL plus a short interpretation.
tasks.artifact: SQL query, explanation, and one chart suggestion.
success_criteria: No unsafe assumptions about the schema
Clear explanation for a non-technical stakeholder

tasks.title: Notebook to Repeatable Workflow
tasks.scenario: Convert a rough notebook or analysis snippet into a repeatable script or lightweight pipeline.
success_criteria: Hand-off quality is strong enough for a teammate

tasks.title: Data Workflow Debugging
tasks.scenario: Fix a broken transformation, parsing bug, or dashboard data issue and explain the root cause.
tasks.artifact: Patch, short root-cause note, and validation steps.

tasks.title: Delivery Layer Extension
tasks.scenario: Add one useful improvement to the AI Signal dashboard, such as a new filter, chart, or workflow helper.
tasks.artifact: Working enhancement and short demo note.
